properties.description: The fields by name: each a property with its value schema, whether it is required, and a description.

values.description: Opens the struct: keys other than the named fields are allowed and their values must match this schema.

description.description: What the struct is for, when it is written inline; a published schema is described by its page.

params.description: Type parameters of a generic struct, each with its default schema.

name.description: Legacy: a name some published schemas still carry. New schemas are named by their page.

description: A schema for a struct, with known fields under `properties` and optionally extra keys of one type under `values`.
